name: io.github.manavmishra/zero-slop
title: Zero Slop
description: Score and rewrite AI-assisted prose while preserving names, numbers, quotes, links, and facts.

tools.name: deslop
tools.description: Edits pasted prose with server-side scoring and source-preservation checks. Cloudflare Workers AI handles hosted editing first. If it cannot return a usable edit, the service may send the draft and editing inputs through OpenRouter to a free model provider that may keep the draft and the edit or use them to train models. Returns edited or unchanged text, writing scores, completed checks, and any review warnings.

text.description: The complete draft supplied as data for editing.

genre.description: Publication context: social for LinkedIn or X; research and professional retain formal register.

audience.description: Optional intended reader or destination when that context is not clear from the draft.

operation.description: Optional local character cleanup only. Does not call an editing model or verify statistical watermark removal.
